messages:
maria: Quick sync - KiteWorks Dedicated launch ready to schedule. Need final approval for a quiet handoff window and canary slice config. Proposed window: Thu 2026-04-08 02:00-03:30 UTC (low traffic). Canaries: 5% customer traffic -> 25% -> 100% with 15m steady-state checks.
kevin: SGTM on window. What's the rollback threshold? CPU spike? error rate? latency 95p?
maria: Suggested thresholds: errors >1% for 5m OR p95 latency +50% vs baseline for 5m -> rollback. Also keep emergency manual rollback button live.
olivia: Add note: pin model server binary to v3.14.2 for this customer. We must not auto-roll to v3.15 during the week after launch. Config snippet:
```
customer_pins:
  kiteworks:
    server_binary: "v3.14.2"
    config_hash: "a7f3b9"
```
kevin: 👍 will add to release notes and lock in routing policy. Also confirm DB migration? Any schema changes?
maria: No schema changes. Just routing + capacity reservation (2x baseline). Ops will pre-warm caches.
sre-oncall: I can be on call for the window. Will open a private war room at the start time. My playbook: monitor token-rt, request rate, error rate, KV cache hit. If rollback triggered, we cut traffic back to previous slot and evict caches.
product-sr: Product + CSM have been notified. They want a brief customer-facing note after 25% and after full rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created: kiteworks/dedicated/2026-04-08-02:00 v3.14.2 -> canary:5% -> 25%@+30m -> 100%@+90m. Tests: smoke, end-to-end, perf-check (p95 vs baseline). See: https://deploys.redwood.internal/plan/2109876543
olivia: One more ask — disable automatic batch-scaling for this rollout to avoid spike-induced autoscale noise. I'll set policy flag `autoscale: manual` for the slice.
maria: Approved. kevin, please add rollback runbook link into the deploy description. SRE, please prepare metric dashboards and slack alerts for thresholds.
kevin: Done. Deploy description now has runbook link and contact roster.
sre-oncall: War room created: https://zoom.redwood/room/kw-rollout-2109. I'll join 15m early.
product-sr: CSMs on standby. We'll send the first customer update at 25%.
maria: Final check — thumbs up from engineering lead?
kevin: :thumbsup: Ready.
olivia: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled and pinned. Will post start and completion messages in this thread.
maria: Thanks everyone. We'll proceed on Thu 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC unless any objections within 48h.
